result.reason: The clause adds the required professional/workmanlike, legal-compliance, no-malicious-code, conformance, and remedy concepts, but it does not provide the required 90-day service warranty (or even the 30-day fallback). The 12-month Site conformance period also runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance, potentially expiring before later deliverables receive the intended coverage. The added termination-without-penalty and elimination of any Termination Payment go beyond the warranty playbook and unnecessarily alter termination economics. In addition, a refund of fees 'payable' is conceptually imprecise because unpaid fees would ordinarily be waived rather than refunded.
